newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures mixed in choppy trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures mixed in choppy trade.

text.p: May 9 - U.S. stock index futures were mixed in choppy midday trading, with action light overall. June S&P 500s slightly higher after support at 818.00-818.50 held, traders said. Further support at 816.00 to 817.00, resistance at 827.00, 832.00 and 834.50. A challenge of 834.50 could launch contract to new record highs, traders said.
